method: tekken_base Lei Wulong -> Wang Jinrei; Lei claim removed in full.
Removed the T7 Lei playable layer (571 moves) and the Lei stance_after map (Five Animals stances) from this file; both live complete in rave.json, Lei's own file.
Wired Wang's full decoded T6 kit as the wang_kit layer (254 records / 70 unique commands); surviving playable entries whose input matches a Wang command carry a t6_wang ref.

Playable frame/damage/anim rows remain the T3 jin bank this file has always run: the Wang sources in our holdings contain names and commands only, no frame data, damage or anim bank (same proxy-bank pattern as Dio on heihachi and Slice on bryan).
WH-original signatures Wrong Foot and Sickness Pattern preserved verbatim.

removed_lei_layer.where_lei_lives: game/assets/movesets/rave.json (1,086 moves: 526 t7:lei + 266 t3:lei anim refs, plus the same Five Animals stance map). Nothing was lost from the repo; the data was a duplicate claim inside Byou's file.

legacy_fields.t7_import_note: Full T7 Lei Wulong movelist (524 rows, t7chicken) imported 2026-10-23; +47 genuinely-missing rows from rbnorway T7 frame data (verified absent from t7chicken: RLX/SIT ground stances, FC/SS/BT basics). Existing T3-proxy moves kept verbatim. No T8 data used.

gaps: No Wang frame data or damage exists in any source we hold (the T6 PSP COM decode yields names + glyph commands only; Wang is not in Tekken 7 or 8, and his TTT2 motbin was never decoded). Wang commands with no surviving playable entry are wired as kit data only (playable_entry: false in wang_kit) rather than given invented numbers.
No Wang animation bank exists in our holdings, so anim_refs on playable rows remain t3:jin, the bank this file has always run.
21 of the 254 Wang records carry no decoded command (language name strings without glyphs); listed in wang_kit.undecoded_records, not guessed.
Stance data: the Lei Five Animals stance_after map was removed with the Lei layer. No Wang stance table exists in our sources, so stance_after is empty rather than fabricated.
